label: 7. Rouge has invited Rupee to join the group.

lines.text: Unlocks: Clear event stage 101620112 · After Anis chat 5. Commander.
Rouge has invited Rupee to join the group.
Rouge has invited Viper to join the group.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: Per Mustang's request, I have added Rupee and Viper to the group chat.

lines.speaker: rupee_b
lines.text: Hello everyone!!

lines.speaker: viper_b
lines.text: Thanks for inviting me! :)

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Cool, now the group'll be more lively!

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: Greetings!
Why did Mustang want them in the group all of a sudden?

lines.speaker: rupee_b
lines.text: Don't tell me you've already forgotten, Sweetie!

lines.speaker: rupee_b
lines.text: Didn't we talk about this before?

lines.speaker: rupee_b
lines.text: Mustang is coming up with a new event.

lines.speaker: viper_b
lines.text: One that we decided to participate in.

lines.speaker: viper_b
lines.text: I'm Viper, a bunny with a venomous bite!

lines.speaker: rupee_b
lines.text: And I'm Rupee, the most luxurious bunny of them all!

lines.speaker: rupee_b
lines.text: Not bad, huh?

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Awesome!

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Then I'll be Blanc, the adorable white bunny.

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: That suits you perfectly.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: I'm not sure I agree.
I don't feel there's a place for me in this conversation,
so perhaps I should bow out and let everyone chat amongst themselves.
Well, I'm going to exit the group.

lines.speaker: rupee_b
lines.text: But why?!

lines.speaker: viper_b
lines.text: Yeah, why?

lines.speaker: viper_b
lines.text: You're the main focus of this entire group.
Me?

lines.speaker: rupee_b
lines.text: That's right!

lines.speaker: rupee_b
lines.text: Four bunnies, or hares, if you will, fight amongst themselves for the favor of one solitary tortoise.

lines.speaker: rupee_b
lines.text: That's you, Sweetie, hehe!
Why wasn't I made aware of this?

lines.speaker: viper_b
lines.text: We only just heard about it ourselves,

lines.speaker: viper_b
lines.text: right before we were invited to this group.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: She's right.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: I didn't know about it either.

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: Me neither.
Isn't this all a bit... inappropriate?

lines.speaker: rupee_b
lines.text: Let's work hard and make this event just as big a success as the last!

lines.speaker: viper_b
lines.text: We're gonna have a blast!

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: Let me confirm the dates first.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Noir and I can help you with any luck that you need, Pit Boss.

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: Yeah, we're here whenever you need us!
Unfortunately, it seems that the event has already...

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Where are you, Pit Boss?

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: In the Commander's Room?

lines.speaker: viper_b
lines.text: No! I think he's in the park.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Right!
Nobody is listening to me.
... So much for my luck.
